snapshot.title: Drone Sighting — Creek Test Area Perimeter

fields.organization: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Security & Safety
fields.location: Creek Test Area, edge of woods near TP-CTA-LP1 (creek meadow gate)
fields.summary: A drone with a red light on top was observed flying low over the residential backyard at 12:30 near the Creek Test Area perimeter. The aircraft made a circular pattern, altitude estimated at 200 ft AGL. A pilot was heard on a walkie-talkie near the woods, saying, 'We’re clear, go again.' No person was seen, but the noise was louder than standard flight. The resident is concerned for public safety and has not approached the area.

findings.notes: Unregistered aircraft (RID-BM-12-004) detected via local receiver (RDR-CTA-01).
No alert triggered in HWP-DETECT-01 console.
Audio recorded from walkie-talkie (CH 462.2625 MHz) contains 'We’re clear, go again' — no known Group operator on frequency.
Drone observed over public event area during NO FLY day.
No aircraft in vicinity per FAA flight data.
Creek Test Area gate (TP-CTA-LP1) is secured and locked.
No security officer visible at perimeter.
Estimated 1.2 km west of Hangar 1, in public park near woods.

actionsTaken: Reported to Security (SEC) via mobile phone at 13:18
Instructed resident not to approach the area
Forwarded report to Harwick Police Command and ASO for incident log entry
recommendations: Verify if any Group personnel were operating near Creek Test Area at 12:30
Review GCS-01 telemetry and link logs from 12:30 for anomalies
Coordinate with Harwick Police for on-site investigation of pilot location
Update incident folder on HUOG-NAS01 with new evidence (FIR-2026-1025-131802)
fields.photosNote: 1 photo attached: IMG-20261025-131802-0044 (drone shadow over backyard, red light visible)

snapshot.instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The resident's report confirms an unauthorized operator near the test area and adds verbal confirmation of a pilot, increasing the threat of intentional evasion.
